title: Embeddings turn IDs into vectors
summary: An embedding is a list of numbers used to represent a token. Models learn useful representations during training. Here we choose tiny lists by hand.
introduction: An embedding is a list of numbers used to represent a token. Models learn useful representations during training. Here we choose tiny lists by hand. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain embeddings turn ids into vectors
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An embedding is a list of numbers used to represent a token. Models learn useful representations during training. Here we choose tiny lists by hand.
The output is [0.2, 0.8]. This is the chosen two-number representation for ID 1. The values are illustrative and have no learned meaning.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Give a third ID its own two-number list.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: An embedding coordinate is not usually a simple dictionary definition.
For more detail later, use this [Large Language Models further reading](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1).
